annotationRationale: Vieta’s formulas determine each pair’s reciprocal sum, and arithmetic averaging implements the harmonic-mean definition. The discriminant establishes that every quadratic contributes two real roots.
sourceMethod: Follows the first official solution, including the checks that all roots are real, nonzero, and distinct across factors.

review.mathCheck: Each factor has positive discriminant and nonzero roots; a shared root between two factors forces their indices to agree. There are therefore 4050 distinct real roots. Vieta gives reciprocal sum −4/3 per pair, so the total is −2700. The harmonic mean is \(4050/(-2700)=-3/2\), choice B.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, originally worded adaptation of MAA solution 12's first approach on page 9. It preserves the real-root and distinctness checks, paired Vieta calculation, averaging, and final reciprocal.
review.annotationCheck: All necessary root-count and denominator checks are present. Vieta and arithmetic averaging are appropriately assessed; the discriminant is correctly recorded as supporting knowledge. The harmonic-mean definition is supplied by the question.
